title: VIPBench: A Human-Aligned Benchmark for Voice Identity Perception in the Age of Voice Cloning
abstract: arXiv:2611.05638v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speaker-recognition benchmarks test how accurately a model recovers the speaker label of a recording, treating voice identity as a property of the person who produced it. However, these benchmarks do not evaluate how humans perceive voice identity. Whether a listener hears two voices as the same person has consequences for intellectual property rights, cybersecurity, and everyday life. We introduce the Voice Identity Perception benchmark (VIPBench), which contains 124,876 same-or-different judgments from 1,290 listeners on 9,800 recording pairs from 100 public figures. The pairs include real recordings, voice clones generated by a text-to-speech system, and morphs between two speakers' voices. We also define four tasks that evaluate the alignment between speaker-representation models and human identity perception. translated_title: VIPBench：语音克隆时代与人类感知对齐的语音身份感知基准
translated_abstract: 说话人识别基准测试的是模型从录音中恢复说话人标签的准确程度，将语音身份视为发声者个人的一种属性。然而，这些基准并未评估人类是如何感知语音身份的。听者是否将两个声音听成同一个人，关系到知识产权、网络安全和日常生活的方方面面。我们提出了语音身份感知基准（VIPBench），其中包含1,290名听者对来自100位公众人物的9,800对录音所作出的124,876次“相同或不同”判断。这些录音配对包括真实录音、由文本转语音系统生成的语音克隆，以及两个说话人声音之间的融合体。我们还定义了四个任务，用以评估说话人表示模型与人类身份感知之间的对齐程度。前两个任务衡量模型的相似度分数能在多大程度上预测回答“相同”的听者比例……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出VIPBench——首个与人类感知对齐的语音身份感知基准，包含1,290名听者对9,800对真实录音、语音克隆和声音融合样本的12万余次“相同或不同”判断，用于评估说话人表示模型与人类身份感知之间的对齐程度。
en_tdlr: VIPBench is a human-aligned benchmark for voice identity perception, containing 124,876 same-or-different judgments from 1,290 listeners on 9,800 pairs of real recordings, voice clones, and speaker morphs, designed to evaluate how well speaker-representation models align with human identity perception.
